differences.design: The design writes "1 change: Tier 2 $0.00–$100.00: 22% margin." (3.12).
differences.closed_by: PO ruling, Matt Barge 16 Nov 2026, question 15 (chosen (c)): Save message in three forms per tier (one rule / per-range bullets / multiple rules). PRD: IN v38: S4-R12 + messages table. Cases rewritten or released 16 Nov 2026 (po-answers-2026-11-16/PASS-REPORT.md).
differences.ruling_verbatim: (c) It depends on what changed, per tier: • One rule and value across every range of the tier: the PRD's form, "1 change: Tier 5 is 28% margin." • The same rule type with a different value in each range: "Tier 5 is" followed by a bullet list of each range's rule, for example "• $0.00 to $25.00: 35% margin • $25.01 to $100.00: 28% margin". • More than one rule type in the tier: "Tier 5 is multiple rules" followed by a bullet list of the types, for example "• + $ • Margin %". The toast's "up to three changes, then and <n> more" rule (S4-R12) still applies; each tier is one item. PRD fix needed: S4-R12 and the messages table get these three forms. Canvas 3.12 and the build follow.

differences.ruling_verbatim: (b) Start at Pricing, as the design draws it: Pricing › Tiers › [tier name] and Pricing › Matrices › [matrix name]. A Settings crumb would need a page to return to.
